name: Dr. Leena Sonekar
bioMarathi: कार्डियोलॉजी व डायबिटीजवरीत विशेषज्ञ टेस्टिंग प्रकृतिकृत डॉ. लीना सोणकर
bioEnglish: Dr. Leena Sonekar is an accomplished Consultant Physician holding an MD in General Medicine. With a primary clinical focus on Cardiology and Diabetology, she provides evidence-based, compassionate care for complex multi-system health conditions, cardiovascular management, and metabolic disorders.

profile.headline: Consulting Physician | Special Interest in Cardiology & Diabetology
profile.executiveSummary: Dr. Leena Sonekar is an accomplished Consultant Physician holding an MD in General Medicine. With a primary clinical focus on Cardiology and Diabetology, she provides evidence-based, compassionate care for complex multi-system health conditions, cardiovascular management, and metabolic disorders.

keyAreasOfExpertise.title: General Internal Medicine
keyAreasOfExpertise.description: Comprehensive diagnosis, acute illness management, and long-term care for complex adult medical conditions.

keyAreasOfExpertise.title: Cardiology & Cardiovascular Wellness
keyAreasOfExpertise.description: Prevention, diagnosis, and therapeutic management of hypertension, ischemic heart disease, and vascular health.

keyAreasOfExpertise.title: Diabetology & Metabolic Care
keyAreasOfExpertise.description: Personalized glycemic control strategies, lifestyle modification plans, and management of diabetes complications.

profile.practiceLocation: Primary Location: Kalyan, Thane / Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), Maharashtra, India.
